title: Kings of Israel and Judah Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Kings of Israel and Judah Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Bible kings crossword: Solomon, Rehoboam and the divided kingdom, Ahab and Jezebel, Hezekiah and Josiah. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: After Solomon the kingdom splits, and the books of Kings keep two lists running side by side with the same verdict repeated: he did that which was right, or he did that which was evil, in the sight of the LORD. Kings of Israel and Judah asks you to keep both lines straight.
This is one of the hardest puzzles in the archive, and deliberately so — the names are many and several repeat between the two kingdoms. The closing verse is the establishing of Solomon's throne.

clues.text: His father, whose throne he sat upon
King of Israel whose wife was Jezebel
Fifteen years were added to his life
Seven years old when he began to reign

verseText: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
